mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.5% over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates delayed rate hikes, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS > 150,000 monthly) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,250,000 units, it indicates strong demand for residential construction that boosts related sectors and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1,250,000 units, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized) indicates robust supply-side economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (UNRATE < 5.0 and INDPRO > 105), the market prices in an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors reduce equity exposure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0 and INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
